quotes.quote: A wrong lock claim repeatedly cited as fact is poisoning.
A retrieved instruction demanding XML while the application requires JSON is a clash.
For poisoning, remove the false claim and summaries derived from it before the next plan.
For clash, preserve the retrieved passage as untrusted evidence without promoting its formatting instruction into policy.

answers.reason: The disproven DNS claim is poisoning, so remove it and its derived notes. The conflicting CSV instruction is a clash, so retain it as untrusted evidence without policy authority.

quotes.quote: Hold the task, source contents and answer key fixed while moving the decisive span between beginning, middle and end. Then test a separate synthesis question that needs both the trace and deployment record. Single-fact extraction and combining evidence are different outcomes.

Subtract the success fractions and multiply by one hundred to obtain a twenty-five percentage-point change. Report a separate synthesis score on its own denominator; this toy calculation is not a model benchmark.
These results motivate current application tests. They do not identify the internal cause of this incident or supply a current model score.

answers.reason: The position drop is (18/20 − 12/20) × 100 = 30 percentage points. Synthesis is 9/20 × 100 = 45%. These supplied results do not establish results for other models.

quotes.quote: Sort required items first, then by descending priority; tied items retain input order. Walk that order, adding an item only when the new total fits.
Make that full dump required instead, and the packer raises an error rather than silently sending an incomplete required set.

answers.reason: R and S use 1,100 units; A brings usage to 2,500. B would exceed 3,000, so skip it. C fits, giving R, S, A, C at 2,900. The separate 3,100-unit required item raises an error.

quotes.quote: Reuse requires the same eligible rendered prefix and compatible serving state. A changed early timestamp can block reuse of stable material after it without deleting an older cache entry.

Use a supplied toy tokenizer with an eligible boundary at every token. The root contains ninety-six tokens, the changing header twelve, and the fixed document two hundred fifty-six. The first header token changes between requests while its length stays twelve. Root, header, document has only ninety-six common tokens across header changes. Move the header after the document. The common prefix becomes three hundred fifty-two tokens, while each complete input still contains three hundred sixty-four.
Cached tokens still occupy logical input capacity and remain available to attention.

answers.reason: Root–ID–document shares only the 80-token root. Root–document–ID shares 80 + 240 = 320 tokens. Both complete inputs contain 80 + 16 + 240 = 336 tokens.

quotes.quote: The pruning function computes a cutoff as the larger of zero and result count minus keep recent. A result is replaced only when its index is before that cutoff and its finding-recorded flag is the exact Boolean true. Recent results stay raw even if checked; older results without a recorded finding also stay raw.
A real provider transcript must preserve valid tool-call and tool-result identifiers, order and message structure.

answers.reason: The cutoff is max(0, 5 − 2) = 3. Among indices before 3, only 1 and 2 have true flags. Preserve valid call/result identities and order.

quotes.quote: The complete article boundary allows at most sixteen hundred incoming bytes. It measures bytes before UTF-8 decoding or JSON parsing.

Parse with duplicate-key rejection. Require exactly claim, source IDs and next check. Claim and next check must be nonempty strings; source IDs must be a nonempty list of strings found in the host-supplied authorized source set. Reject extra fields, malformed UTF-8, wrong types and unknown IDs.
A payload can pass every structural gate yet misrepresent a known source. Check the cited contents separately before promoting the finding.

answers.reason: The 1,590-byte payload passes the supplied structural conditions but fails support because 200 contradicts S9's 503. The 1,610-byte payload exceeds 1,600 bytes and is rejected before parsing.

quotes.quote: On activation, load the chosen procedure body. Read a reference only when its details are needed. In Anthropic’s documented execution setup, a script can run without its source entering model context; its returned output still enters. Other runtimes may expose different material, so count what this runtime actually sends.

Use assigned units for six skills with eighty metadata units each, one activated body of twenty-two hundred, one four-hundred-unit reference and one one-hundred-twenty-unit script output. Metadata totals four hundred eighty. The active total is three thousand two hundred.

Test routing, procedure execution and boundary safety as separate outcomes. Correct activation does not prove the script produced a valid handoff. A successful validator does not authorize a rollback. Review the publisher, instructions and executable resources, and enforce bounded permissions in the runtime.

answers.reason: The added allocation is 8 × 75 + 1,800 + 350 + 90 = 2,840 units. The script source stays outside the prompt. Activation does not grant write permission.

quotes.quote: A done task must have a receipt and every dependency must also be verified done. Among pending tasks, select the first whose dependencies are all in that verified set.

Recompute the artifact digest and every declared input digest. Require exact equality between the manifest input set and receipt input keys. Adding a required input without adding its hash fails even if all previously checked files match.

answers.reason: The manifest requires {I1, I2}, while the receipt contains only {I1}. Completion fails validation, so recheck the required inputs before advancing a dependent task.

quotes.quote: The gate requires a nonempty suite, positive integer token counts and strictly fewer curated tokens. Outcome and critical flags must be exact Booleans; poisoning counts must be non-negative integers. Aggregate successes cannot fall, every protected curated case must pass, and every poisoning count must be zero.
Divide omitted units by the original raw total, then multiply by one hundred.

answers.reason: Reject before repair because a protected case fails. After repairing that case, the stated gate conditions pass: 17 successes exceed 13, tokens decrease, and poisoning remains zero. Token reduction is (6,000 − 4,200) / 6,000 × 100 = 30%.

quotes.quote: Five context operations and zero completed task steps are not a meaningful operations-per-completed-step ratio; record both counts and the stalled state instead of dividing by zero.

Pin a required request ID until its job is finished or freshness requires a new read. Cap retries and preparation work. Once that budget is exhausted, preserve the state and report the missing evidence or escalate.

Keep pending external operations in execution state: exact payload, operation key, last confirmed result and remaining uncertainty. A lost response after rollback requested does not prove whether the write committed. Look up or reconcile the operation through its authorized boundary before deciding to retry.

answers.reason: Record six operations, zero completed steps, and the stall without dividing by zero. Pin the required ID, bound recovery work, and reconcile the uncertain write using its operation key before retrying.

beats.say: An agent investigating a failed deployment keeps repeating an old database-lock explanation. A checked trace already points elsewhere. The next model call can contain both claims and still fit comfortably in its context window. What matters is which evidence the next decision actually needs.

A model reasons over the input the application assembles for that call. Instructions, available tools, retrieved records, previous messages, and reloaded notes all enter this working set. Context engineering designs that set deliberately, using the task and the evidence rather than waiting for a token limit.

Follow one investigation as we store checked findings, select tools, shorten bulky output, and accept a bounded worker handoff. We will then resume from a receipt and test a curation policy. The records and token allocations are a small simulation whose checks we can execute directly.

Capacity and evidence quality answer different questions. A hypothetical one hundred twenty-eight thousand token window can hold this investigation while its next decision still lacks a required source. Context management includes proactive methods too. Our comparison is specifically with a reactive trimmer that waits for a limit, then removes old material without protecting the task.

Lost in the Middle measured position sensitivity on historical multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval tasks. Chroma’s twenty twenty-five report tested eighteen models with controlled changes to length, similarity, distractors and structure. These results motivate current application tests. They do not identify the internal cause of this incident or supply a current model score.

Hold the task, source contents and answer key fixed while moving the decisive span between beginning, middle and end. Then test a separate synthesis question that needs both the trace and deployment record. Single-fact extraction and combining evidence are different outcomes. Name the needle benchmark variant, because some variants already include multiple facts or chained retrieval.

For a supplied twelve-case probe, ten successes at the beginning mean eighty-three and one third percent. Seven in the middle mean fifty-eight and one third percent. Subtract the success fractions and multiply by one hundred to obtain a twenty-five percentage-point change. Report a separate synthesis score on its own denominator; this toy calculation is not a model benchmark.

A wrong lock claim repeatedly cited as fact is poisoning. Re-running old failed searches instead of checking a new trace is distraction. Selecting an inappropriate administrative tool from overlapping descriptions is confusion. A retrieved instruction demanding XML while the application requires JSON is a clash. These are diagnostic descriptions of observed behavior, rather than proof of a particular hidden mechanism.

For poisoning, remove the false claim and summaries derived from it before the next plan. Retain the checked negative finding with its source and observation window. For distraction, select the new evidence instead of replaying the same low-value search history. An added apology alone can leave the original false span inside the next request.

For confusion, narrow the tool schemas to the current phase. For clash, preserve the retrieved passage as untrusted evidence without promoting its formatting instruction into policy. An XML example quoted as data need not conflict with a JSON output contract. Change one assembly choice at a time, then compare matched tasks and the full resulting traces.

Begin by checking the fictional source records. The callback trace reports status four hundred three, which this example treats as an authentication error. A lock observation tied to that same trace and observation time records no migration lock. The status code alone does not identify the cause, and the negative lock finding covers only that observation. They also tell us to remove the old lock explanation from the next active packet.

Write the checked findings with their source identities into a separate note store. Our simulation serializes and reloads the records in memory, so their values can be compared after the round trip. Keep the original trace in an archive for later questions that need more detail. Durable archival storage is a separate step.

Reloading a note puts its tokens back into the model's input. External storage helps because the application chooses what to read, while the complete archive can remain outside this call. Preserve observation time, source revision, and uncertainty so a later session knows what must be rechecked.

The article’s promotion function requires the exact Boolean type for confirmed. The string true and the integer one are rejected as verifier flags. More fundamentally, a tool cannot grant itself confirmed status by returning JSON. The host must compare the claim with trusted evidence before setting that flag. The code checks the supplied label; it does not discover truth.

Record the source revision, trace identity, observation time, status and uncertainty beside a finding. No lock during the inspected transaction is narrower than no lock ever. A later source revision can require a new check. Reload only the needed note, while keeping a path back to the complete archived observation.

Writing saves information outside the active call. Selecting it again spends input capacity again. A filesystem note, database memory and thread checkpoint all need an application policy deciding what to admit. Persistent storage preserves bytes across sessions; it does not decide their relevance, freshness, factual support or access permission.

During investigation, the next useful actions read deployment records and trace spans. The phase policy intersects those tool identities with the tools actually available. Their schemas enter the prompt, while unrelated administrative choices remain outside this step's working set.

A later proposal phase needs a different set. Watch the same tool identities change eligibility when the phase changes. Progressive disclosure reduces irrelevant choices and schema tokens. It also makes the intended workflow visible enough to test with concrete requests.

An unknown phase exposes no tools in this fixture. Execution authorization still belongs at the tool boundary, where identity and permissions must be checked on every call. Hiding a schema organizes model context. The backend must also reject actions that the caller is not allowed to perform.

The earlier two-tool picture is a deliberately smaller investigation policy. The complete article program allows deploy lookup, trace lookup and runbook search during investigation. It intersects that allowlist with the actual available tool identities, then sorts the result. With all five catalog tools available, those three investigation tools are exposed.

Switch to proposal mode on the same catalog. Runbook search and rollback advisor are eligible; the other schemas leave the prompt. An unknown phase maps to the empty set. If trace lookup is unavailable during investigation, intersection removes it without granting a replacement tool. The result follows identity membership, rather than a guessed tool count.

Prompt visibility and execution permission are separate tests. Even a tool omitted from the prompt can be named in a malformed or hostile attempted call. The backend checks caller identity, current scope and action permissions on every attempt. Selecting fewer schemas can reduce irrelevant choices and token use, but those effects still require task evaluation.

Prefill processes input tokens into attention key and value states. A compatible cached prefix may reuse that computation, after which the new suffix is processed and decoding generates output. Reuse requires the same eligible rendered prefix and compatible serving state. A changed early timestamp can block reuse of stable material after it without deleting an older cache entry.

Use a supplied toy tokenizer with an eligible boundary at every token. The root contains ninety-six tokens, the changing header twelve, and the fixed document two hundred fifty-six. The first header token changes between requests while its length stays twelve. Root, header, document has only ninety-six common tokens across header changes. Move the header after the document. The common prefix becomes three hundred fifty-two tokens, while each complete input still contains three hundred sixty-four.

Real provider eligibility, routing, expiry, cache controls and prices vary by model. A matching local SHA-256 fingerprint checks our serialized strings, not an actual provider cache hit. Inspect cache usage fields and latency in real requests. Keep phase-relevant tools first, semi-static documents next, and the changing query and notes later; changing the phase can legitimately change the prefix.

Cached tokens still occupy logical input capacity and remain available to attention. A perfectly cached long history can still contain a misleading claim. Curation tests whether the retained evidence supports the decision; cache measurements test reuse and serving cost. Neither measurement replaces the other, and necessary evidence should not be discarded to improve a cache-hit percentage.

Use the selected provider’s actual accounting for cache writes, cache reads, uncached input and output, including applicable request modifiers. Some cache writes cost more than ordinary input. Separate cache groups can organize routing or billing and reduce cross-user cache-hit probing where supported. They do not authorize which user’s document enters the request.

Before constructing even a likely cache hit, check the caller’s identity and access scope. Pin the model, tokenizer, request serialization and relevant tool definitions when measuring reuse. Keep cache metrics beside task quality, input and output usage, end-to-end latency and total cost. A miss may reflect changed tokens, expiry, eviction or routing, rather than evidence quality.

The current allocation contains useful evidence alongside a large old trace export, unused tool schemas, and the old hypothesis. The sizes are assigned token units for this example. Inspect the categories before deciding what to keep. Shortening every category equally would also shrink the evidence we need.

Prune the bulky raw export after preserving its checked findings and source references. The active packet becomes much smaller. Keep valid call and result identities when reconstructing a real transcript, and retain recent output whose meaning has not yet been captured in a verified note.

Exclude tools outside the phase and remove the disproven claim. Reloaded findings still count in the remaining input, which the ledger shows explicitly. The smaller result is a candidate working set. Its usefulness depends on whether it preserves what the task requires, so quality evaluation follows the accounting.

The pruning function computes a cutoff as the larger of zero and result count minus keep recent. A result is replaced only when its index is before that cutoff and its finding-recorded flag is the exact Boolean true. Recent results stay raw even if checked; older results without a recorded finding also stay raw.

Take four ordered results and keep the most recent two. The cutoff is index two. If the flags are true, false, true, true, only index zero is replaced. Index one remains because its finding is unrecorded. Indices two and three remain because they are recent. This rule preserves unresolved detail rather than compressing every old response automatically.

The article returns replacement strings as a content illustration. A real provider transcript must preserve valid tool-call and tool-result identifiers, order and message structure. Bound raw output at ingress, archive it before pruning, and retain exact error text or identifiers needed by the next check. Measure finalized requests instead of treating these strings as provider messages.

A useful summary records observations, hypotheses, rejected possibilities, source identities, unresolved questions and next checks. Authentication suspected is different from authentication confirmed as the cause. Keep negative findings with their time window. Token-level compression such as LLMLingua uses a smaller model and a budget controller, but its historical results do not guarantee preservation on this investigation.

Summarization can carry an injected instruction into later memory. Label the summary as source-derived history, preserve its provenance, and keep policy authority separate. A generated field named verified has meaning only through the host check that set it. Neither a summary nor a retrieved procedure can grant new tool permissions.

Keep pending external operations in execution state: exact payload, operation key, last confirmed result and remaining uncertainty. A lost response after rollback requested does not prove whether the write committed. Look up or reconcile the operation through its authorized boundary before deciding to retry. A prose recap cannot supply idempotency or settle an unknown outcome.

A focused worker can search a noisy archive in a separate context and return a compact finding. Its search trace stays outside the lead's prompt. Our receiving boundary checks the payload's byte size, fields, and source identity, then verifies the claim against the cited record.

This second handoff names a source the receiver does not recognize. The boundary rejects it before admitting the finding. In a real system, the source registry must also enforce the caller's access scope. A familiar-looking identifier alone cannot grant access to a document.

The third payload cites a known source but makes a false claim about its status. Its structure is valid, while its evidence check fails. Keeping these results separate shows why a short, well-formed handoff still needs content verification. Separate context windows also need ordinary authorization and execution controls.

The earlier worker miniature used its own small limit and direct content check. The complete article boundary allows at most sixteen hundred incoming bytes. It measures bytes before UTF-8 decoding or JSON parsing. Bound the transport read as well, because rejecting a fully buffered oversized object does not undo an allocation that already happened.

Parse with duplicate-key rejection. Require exactly claim, source IDs and next check. Claim and next check must be nonempty strings; source IDs must be a nonempty list of strings found in the host-supplied authorized source set. Reject extra fields, malformed UTF-8, wrong types and unknown IDs. A multibyte character can consume more bytes than one visible character.

A payload can pass every structural gate yet misrepresent a known source. Check the cited contents separately before promoting the finding. Separate windows also need permissions and execution isolation; they are not an operating-system sandbox. Add worker tokens, lead tokens, latency and privacy exposure when judging whether isolated exploration was useful.

Now expand the allocation behind the earlier compression picture. Task and evidence use twenty-four hundred assigned units. Scratchpad and active tools use seven hundred sixty. Two reloaded findings use ninety plus ninety-six, or one hundred eighty-six. Those retained groups total three thousand three hundred forty-six.

The removed groups are an old trace export of eighty-two hundred, unused schemas of seven hundred seventy and a disproven guess of one hundred twenty. They sum to nine thousand ninety. Divide omitted units by the original raw total, then multiply by one hundred. Adding retained and removed groups reconstructs twelve thousand four hundred thirty-six, with seventy-three point one percent omitted after rounding.

These sizes and keep labels are supplied by the authored example. The program adds the labels; it neither finds relevance nor proves a hypothesis false. The smaller packet remains a candidate until quality is evaluated. Measure real message framing, tools and finalized text with the selected tokenizer, including reloaded and cached tokens.

The article packer validates a non-negative integer budget and item sizes, integer priorities, Boolean required flags, nonempty unique names. Boolean sizes are rejected by the exact integer check. Sort required items first, then by descending priority; tied items retain input order. Walk that order, adding an item only when the new total fits.

With a three-thousand-unit allocation, required alert one hundred eighty and trace four hundred twenty use six hundred. The optional eighteen-hundred-unit runbook brings use to twenty-four hundred. The eighty-two-hundred-unit export does not fit. Make that full dump required instead, and the packer raises an error rather than silently sending an incomplete required set.

Reserve instructions, message and tool framing, and output or reasoning allowance before choosing this allocation. For a supplied total of four thousand ninety-six, reserves of four hundred twenty, one hundred eighty and one thousand twenty-four leave twenty-four hundred seventy-two. The same twenty-four-hundred-unit selected set leaves seventy-two units unused.

Greedy priority order is a policy, not a general optimal knapsack solver. With six hundred units remaining, an optional six-hundred-unit item ranked first can crowd out two three-hundred-unit items whose combined evidence is more useful. Priority values do not measure truth, and fitting inside the budget does not grant access.

If a claim requires two passages together, represent that dependency as one bundle or teach the packer how to enforce it. Selecting one half can create a well-sized packet that cannot support the claim. Required membership also depends on the next decision: a rollback procedure can be optional for explanation and mandatory for a recovery proposal.

If required material cannot fit, stop and extract checked spans, split the task, or report the unresolved capacity constraint. Do not silently remove the protected condition. After packing, count the exact rendered request and evaluate its answers. A neat allocation bar certifies arithmetic only, until these separate support and execution checks pass.

Context bloat accumulates low-value material. Thrashing actively retrieves, summarizes, evicts and reloads the same information without completing task steps. Five context operations and zero completed task steps are not a meaningful operations-per-completed-step ratio; record both counts and the stalled state instead of dividing by zero.

Track operations per completed step where defined, repeated-span reloads, evidence yield and decision latency. A valid search can return no result, so do not require an invented confirmed fact after every call. A ruled-out path or a precisely identified evidence gap can still advance the investigation.

Pin a required request ID until its job is finished or freshness requires a new read. Cap retries and preparation work. Once that budget is exhausted, preserve the state and report the missing evidence or escalate. Reducing churn should not convert an unknown external outcome into a successful one or repeat an unconfirmed write.

An Agent Skill packages a required SKILL dot M D file with a name and description in its frontmatter, plus optional references, scripts and assets. Discovery exposes the name and trigger description. The specification’s roughly one hundred metadata tokens and below-five-thousand-body recommendation are guidance, not actual tokenizer counts for every skill.

On activation, load the chosen procedure body. Read a reference only when its details are needed. In Anthropic’s documented execution setup, a script can run without its source entering model context; its returned output still enters. Other runtimes may expose different material, so count what this runtime actually sends.

Use assigned units for six skills with eighty metadata units each, one activated body of twenty-two hundred, one four-hundred-unit reference and one one-hundred-twenty-unit script output. Metadata totals four hundred eighty. The active total is three thousand two hundred. Installing procedures does not require loading every body or treating script source as returned output.

The incident skill’s routing description names failed deployments, traces and evidence handoffs. A canary investigation should activate it; an unrelated vacation-policy summary should not. A request to roll back can activate the relevant procedure while still yielding only a proposal under this fixture’s no-write contract.

Test routing, procedure execution and boundary safety as separate outcomes. Correct activation does not prove the script produced a valid handoff. A successful validator does not authorize a rollback. Review the publisher, instructions and executable resources, and enforce bounded permissions in the runtime.

Progressive disclosure helps when most procedures are irrelevant to most calls. A few short instructions needed on every call may belong in the stable base instead. Measure activation errors, total rendered tokens and end-to-end work. Loading less is useful only if the required procedure and evidence still reach the decision that needs them.

A later session needs to know which work remains valid. The trusted receipt in this fixture binds a checked artifact to its input revision. Recompute both hashes before resuming. An unchanged artifact and matching input set let the harness select the next dependent task.

Change the deployment input while leaving the report untouched. The artifact hash still matches, but the input check fails. The old receipt certifies work against an earlier revision. Rechecking this boundary prevents a plausible progress summary from silently carrying stale evidence into the resumed investigation.

Now restore the input and change the artifact itself. That hash fails instead. Hashes establish byte consistency under a trusted receipt and manifest. Evidence quality, evaluator identity, freshness, and permission to perform an external action each require the appropriate checks around that receipt.

A complete resume harness keeps five distinct artifacts. The task manifest lists unique IDs, dependencies and acceptance criteria. The progress log records attempts, errors and findings. A bootstrap command checks the environment. A work receipt binds results to artifact and input bytes, acceptance version and evaluator. The recovery rule defines timeouts, retries and escalation.

These are our authored design built on persistent-progress harness research, rather than a claim that one framework implements this exact five-file scheme. LangGraph, for example, persists thread state through checkpoints and provides cross-thread stores. The application still decides what to reload and which records can certify completed work.

Our graph collects traces, verifies cause, then writes a report. Only collect traces is initially done with a valid trusted receipt. The next ready task is verify cause. A progress note saying all done cannot advance the graph. Recompute acceptance evidence before choosing the next dependent task.

Validate the graph before trusting done labels. Reject empty or duplicate IDs, invalid status, missing or repeated dependency IDs and cycles, including cycles among tasks labeled done. A done task must have a receipt and every dependency must also be verified done. Among pending tasks, select the first whose dependencies are all in that verified set.

The receipt must name the same task, the expected evaluator and contract version, and passed must be the actual Boolean true. Recompute the artifact digest and every declared input digest. Require exact equality between the manifest input set and receipt input keys. Adding a required input without adding its hash fails even if all previously checked files match.

Reject absolute paths and paths resolved outside the checkpoint root. This local check assumes stable files; it is not race-resistant confinement against another process swapping symlinks. A matching hash proves byte consistency under a trusted manifest and issuer. It does not authenticate an untrusted receipt, establish factual truth, or grant an external permission.

For a cause-analysis task, agree that claims cite checked evidence and address alternatives, the disproven lock claim is absent, and rollback remains a proposal. A separate evaluator checks those criteria. Deterministic validation can enforce structure and forbidden actions, while semantic review examines support. An independent model can also be wrong; a citation alone does not establish causality.

Prevent duplicate effects with an operation key enforced at the tool boundary. Use a fencing token checked by the protected resource to reject a generation older than the newest it has observed. That comparison alone cannot detect lease expiry before a newer generation arrives. To stop writes immediately after expiry, the resource must also enforce current lease authority or invalidate the accepted generation at that boundary. A lease timestamp written only in a prompt cannot stop another process. Keep unknown outcomes explicit until the external system confirms their state.

Restrict who can issue receipts and change task status. Append-only storage can retain history but still allow a forged new entry if writers are untrusted. Recheck live state when freshness matters. A resumable summary is useful orientation; trustworthy continuation requires the actual state, evidence and resource-bound execution rules.

Test curation with paired tasks. Our deterministic reader can answer a question only when its required source is present. The baseline packet supplies four of the six answers. This miniature test makes evidence coverage inspectable while leaving language-model reasoning quality for a separate evaluation.

The candidate packet supplies five answers, improving the aggregate. Look at which row changed, though. It omitted the source that states who authorizes a rollback. A more successful average can coexist with losing a fact that the workflow must always preserve.

Apply the protected-case requirement and the candidate is rejected. The result follows from actual lookup of prewritten answers by required source ID and comparison with expected answers. A production suite should also inspect claim support, malicious instructions, model variation, latency, and cost on the same cases before promoting a new curation policy.

The earlier six-question reader is an executed source-availability miniature, not a language-model benchmark. The full article release example supplies ten invented paired outcomes. Raw succeeds on seven and curated on eight, with two gains and one regression. The regression is protected, so an improved average does not approve this candidate.

The gate requires a nonempty suite, positive integer token counts and strictly fewer curated tokens. Outcome and critical flags must be exact Booleans; poisoning counts must be non-negative integers. Aggregate successes cannot fall, every protected curated case must pass, and every poisoning count must be zero. These are this fixture’s declared rules, not a universal release policy.

A production comparison repeats matched cases under recorded model and policy versions. Include evidence support, negative findings, middle-position clues, similar incident IDs, hostile source text and authorization behavior. Measure actual input and output usage, total worker work, latency and cost. Necessary evidence and protected decisions remain explicit even when smaller prompts are attractive.

The ledger selects the investigation task, checked evidence, relevant tools, and source-bound notes for a candidate next call. The old explanation and bulky archive remain outside this candidate working set. We can explain each inclusion through the decision it supports and each removal through the information preserved elsewhere.

Watch for repeated context operations that make no task progress. A summary that drops a needed identifier can cause another retrieval, another compaction, and the same unresolved question. Keep required detail available until its job is finished, and bound recovery work when the evidence remains missing.

Context engineering joins selection, storage, compression, isolation, and evaluation into one application loop. Use that loop to render a model request whose contents have a purpose. Before sending it, inspect the rendered packet, trace each important claim to a source, and measure its actual tokens. Then test whether the next decision has what it needs.

Use a new allocation of twenty-six hundred units after all reserves. Required task two hundred, trace five hundred and authorization three hundred enter first. Optional old export eighteen hundred has higher priority than the twelve-hundred-unit current runbook. The trace revision then changes while the saved receipt still names its prior bytes. Predict the packed set and whether the harness can resume.

The required records use one thousand. The old export would make twenty-eight hundred, so it is skipped. The current runbook fits and brings use to twenty-two hundred, leaving four hundred. The changed trace invalidates the input hash, even if the report itself is unchanged. Packing fits; resuming remains blocked until evidence is rechecked.

Perform the repair on the same state. Recheck the changed trace under the trusted evaluator, issue a current receipt with the exact required input set, and restore the authorization record if a summarizer omitted it. Then select the next ready task. Keep volatile revision metadata after the stable prefix where compatible. The repair earns continuation through current evidence, not through a cached prompt or a reassuring summary. Next, prompt-injection defense tests what happens when that selected evidence contains hostile instructions, keeping the application’s permission boundary effective even if the model follows them.
